headline: The Huang relief rally reversed within a session: Semis ETF -7.3% with every AI hardware segment down 4-10%, VIX up 15% to 30.4, and CoreWeave bonds at record lows.
regime: The correction has resumed: S&P 500 -0.5% (in correction territory, 35bdecbbaa11), Nasdaq -1.5%, Semis ETF -7.3% on the day and -21.2% on the month, VIX 30.35 (+65% on the month). Servers (-10.0%), networking (-9.3%) and neoclouds (-8.8%) led losses while cooling (-4.4% on the month) and grid (-10.3%) remain the least damaged AI segments. Credit is now the transmission channel: CoreWeave bonds at record lows (94e10ab53b31, 60e1975b9db2) and record CDS spreads for ORCL, GOOGL and CRWV (abcdb381e840), with money rotating into defensives (d04c2b829685).

theses.title: Power, grid and cooling, not chips, limit the AI build-out
evidence: Cooling -4.4% and grid -10.3% on the month versus compute -26.0% and servers -27.4%
Dell vets backlog for customers' access to 'land and power' (cdd2413c594a); Eaton's record backlog and margins (3f135902498d); BWXT $8.56bn backlog (2503f911564c)
Evercore still sees 58% upside in VRT despite a target cut (782856eadfbb); Bloom Energy revenue +138% (85a7596865cb)
Against: power-construction peers sold hard, AGX -10.1% on a JPM cut (ddb4d64aa62c), NVT -8.4% (67c4c4574bdc), PRIM -17.4% on five days
theses.change_note: -1: relative strength held, but grid and power contractors now trade with the chip tape, so the segments are not a hiding place in a credit-led sell-off.

theses.title: AI compute demand still outruns supply
evidence: Dell AI server sales more than doubled and it raised its annual forecast (cdd2413c594a, 1ba1685e1fe1); AAOI signs a four-year 800G supply deal with a Tier 1 hyperscaler (1ab93ccfc104)
Huang: Vera Rubin generates $40bn revenue per gigawatt vs $25bn for Grace Blackwell (3750767109de)

Against: Dell fell 4.4% on a blowout quarter (8597703a983e); TrendForce cuts DRAM pricing as Chinese cloud orders pull back (0c93535c5ef4); chips sold on renewed doubts over AI spending returns (5b511980573c)
theses.change_note: -3: Dell confirms order flow, but TrendForce's note is the first hard data point of softer demand from a cloud customer group.

theses.title: Debt-funded neoclouds are where the AI cycle breaks first
evidence: All four CoreWeave bond issues at record lows (94e10ab53b31, 60e1975b9db2); record CDS spreads on CRWV, ORCL, GOOGL (abcdb381e840)
Nscale may shelve its $35bn IPO (50b79da0489c); APLD -33% in a month despite a hyperscaler lease (24128f8b2b87); TeraWulf's Muskie has no tenant (c40cf59e73d2)
Neocloud segment -8.8% on the day, -13.6% on five days
theses.change_note: +3: Monday's bounce fully reversed and bond markets, not just equities, are now pricing neocloud default risk.

theses.title: Memory is priced as if this is the peak of the cycle
evidence: STX at 7.4x forward earnings with 40% operating margin; Micron still at a single-digit multiple
Against: TrendForce lowers its DRAM pricing forecast (0c93535c5ef4); BNP cuts its MU target 54% (efcd9d248cd3); memory -29.6% on the month
theses.change_note: -6: a cut to DRAM price forecasts is exactly the evidence that the low multiples may be correct; the case now rests on HDD and NAND rather than DRAM.

theses.title: Hyperscaler capex is eating their free cash flow
evidence: Record CDS spreads on ORCL and GOOGL (abcdb381e840): credit markets now charge for hyperscaler capex
SpaceX's $32bn AI chip debt weighs on it (1689f0d78bcb); AI fears spreading to software loans with a 2028-29 debt wall (056afef49a5a)
Against: hyperscalers only -1.3% on the day, GOOGL -0.4% on five days
theses.change_note: +2: rising CDS spreads on GOOGL and ORCL show debt-funded capex is being priced, even if the equities held up.

theses.title: The AI trade is crowded and rates are high
evidence: Semis -7.3% the day after +15%; VIX 30.35; S&P 500 in correction (35bdecbbaa11); Anthropic below its IPO price (f7d97f5a5074)
Rotation into defensives (d04c2b829685); 10-year still 4.9%
Against: JPMorgan sees S&P 8,200 and argues adoption, not capex, will carry the trade (75159a38f6ea)
theses.change_note: +3: the one-day reversal of the relief rally shows positioning was not cleaned out; buyers are not defending the highs.

theses.title: The Huang probe puts Nvidia, and China export rules, at risk
evidence: NVDA extends losses as the Huang rally fades (923b22716354); Trump says 'not too late' for a US stake in Nvidia (db4df91a30f3)
Nvidia reinstated Huang 'amid compliance' focus (0777531a3a4d); new US tariffs on 16 partners (a9e58ccfd5c7)
theses.change_note: No news on the SEC probe; a possible government stake adds governance risk but offsets with political protection. Held.

theses.title: Vendor and off-balance-sheet financing is propping up AI demand
evidence: Dell carries $4.4bn of lower-grade receivables while HPE won't finance neoclouds (f11f13bc682c)
Dell says its backlog is vetted for customers' access to capital (cdd2413c594a), an admission that some buyers lack it
theses.change_note: +4: the Dell receivables figure is the first quantified vendor-credit exposure in this run.

compute.note: -7.3% on the day, -26.0% on the month; the Huang rally has faded and the SEC probe is open.

foundry_equipment.note: -6.5% on the day but -6.3% on five days; high-margin toolmakers with net cash, CAMT flat on five days.

memory_storage.note: -29.6% on the month; TrendForce DRAM cut and BNP's MU downgrade, but HDD names trade at 7x forward.

networking_optical.note: -9.3% on the day; ALAB and CRDO dumped, but AAOI's four-year 800G deal and COHR insider buying.

servers.note: -10.0% on the day; Dell's beat sold off and it holds $4.4bn of lower-grade receivables.

power_nuclear.note: -4.4% on the day, -14.8% on the month; cash-generative IPPs (VST 7.2x operating cash flow) over SMR developers.

grid_electrical.note: -10.3% on the month, POWL +2.1% on five days; Eaton record backlog, but contractors (AGX, PRIM) sold hard.

cooling_thermal.note: Steadiest segment, -3.1% on five days and -4.4% on the month; MOD +1.1% on five days.

datacenter_neocloud.note: -13.6% on five days; CoreWeave bonds at record lows, Nscale IPO in doubt.

hyperscalers.note: -1.3% on the day, but record CDS spreads on GOOGL and ORCL.

ai_software.note: -28.1% on the month; AI fears spreading to software loans (056afef49a5a).

risks: CoreWeave's bond rout becomes a default or covenant event, cutting orders through the whole supplier chain.
DRAM price cuts spread to HBM and NAND, breaking the memory earnings base.
Fresh US tariffs on 16 trading partners (a9e58ccfd5c7) raise component costs and squeeze hardware margins.
The SEC probe finds misstated Nvidia revenue, forcing estimate cuts across the chain.
Hot PCE inflation data keeps the 10-year near 4.9% and multiples under pressure.
watch: PCE inflation data (d488dfd824e4) and whether the 10-year breaks below 4.85%.
CoreWeave bond prices and CDS on ORCL and GOOGL (abcdb381e840).
Whether VIX holds above 30 or retreats after the semis reversal.
Follow-through on TrendForce's DRAM cut ahead of Micron's December report (f6dc257ebe8e).
Whether cooling and grid hold their relative strength if semis fall again.
